emergency.name: Emergency Reserve
emergency.description: Understand if and when crypto can work as a reserve in systemic crisis scenarios: bail-in, capital controls, account freezes, extreme inflation. And above all: the real limits.

introduction.title: Crypto in emergency situations: when traditional systems don't work

whyExists.content: Cryptocurrencies emerged after the 2008 crisis, when the problem wasn't lack of money, but the inability to use it freely. Closed banks, limited withdrawals, blocked transfers.

problemType.content: The goal was to create a transfer system that didn't depend on a single bank or authority. A system that would continue to work even when traditional ones stop.

mentalRule.content: The central question is not "how much do they yield", but "under what conditions do they continue to work". This completely changes the evaluation approach.

whoItMakesSense.content: In emergencies, priority is access, not optimization. It means considering them as an additional option, not as a replacement for the traditional system.

finalNote.content: This dashboard helps understand when this approach is relevant, what its functioning depends on, and how to avoid discovering its limits at the worst moment.
